verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a pricing-page line stating a Gemini AI assistant is available in Gmail. That implies some natural-language interaction inside one app, but nothing shows the product can be operated across its features through natural-language commands. missing for 10: documentation of what natural-language commands Gemini can perform (drafting, search, actions across Docs/Drive/Calendar/Admin), evidence of command-driven operation beyond Gmail, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
